in_hebrew.name: פריץ
in_hebrew.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Hebrew word ‘perets’, meaning ‘fruit, offspring, fruitfulness’. It is also found in the Bible as the name of a place (Joshua 15:32) and a man (Judges 9:46).

in_greek.name: Περισσός
in_greek.long_meaning: The name ‘Perice’ in Greek is derived from the word ‘perissos’, which means ‘abundance, overflowing, profusion, excess’. This name is not directly found in the New Testament, but it is used in the Septuagint to translate the Hebrew name ‘Peretz’ (Joshua 15:32, Judges 9:46).

in_latin.name: Pericis
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name ‘Pericis’ is derived from the Latin word ‘pericis’, which means ‘fruitful’. It is not directly found in the Latin Vulgate, but it can be derived from the Greek or Hebrew names ‘Perissos’ or ‘Perets’.
